_about: The channel rails on /channels/ (built by build-sections.py through channels_hub.py). Names and schools come from the API's /v1/channels; every channel there with a school gets a rail. 'order' puts these channels first, top to bottom; any other channel with a school follows, A-Z. A rail only shows when the channel has at least minVideos videos, and shows up to count of them. 'logos' maps a channel to its logo file under assets/img (leave a channel out for no logo). 'hidden' keeps a channel off the hub entirely.
